episodes.164894: An unsettled weather pattern set up across South FL as a plume of tropical moisture settled across the region. The excess moisture along with the presence of a surface boundary along the coast promoted heavy rainfall and flooding across portions of Broward County.
episodes.165666: The SPCZ produced heavy rainfall across the territory, mainly in central and western villages on Tutuila.
episodes.166256: Storm force winds occurred over portions of Lake Superior on the 21st in the wake of a strong Clipper low pressure system moving across the Upper Great Lakes region.

events.narrative: The public shared via social media videos of flash flooding in downtown Fort Lauderdale showing water above curbs, over sidewalks, and entering ground floor store fronts.
The public shared via social media videos of flooding on neighborhood streets in Dania Beach. Water was approaching sidewalks and in front of houses.

WSO Pago Pago recorded 2.58 inches between 12:50 AM and 1:50 AM, while at the same time several reports were received of flooding in low-lying areas. Also a power outage in Fagaitua was also reported during the time of this flash flooding event.
ASCC (tipping bucket by Davis Instruments): 2.49 inches between 1 AM and 2 AM.
Rain observations by Meteorologist Joe Laplante at Coconut Point recorded (tipping bucket by Davis Instruments): 4.27 inches between 1 AM and 2 AM.
